description: This file contains database access functions for managing team data in the focalboard project, including CRUD operations for team signup tokens, settings, and retrieval of team information.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: A struct providing methods to interact with the SQL database for team-related data.

methods.name: upsertTeamSignupToken
methods.description: Inserts or updates a team's signup token in the database.

methods.name: upsertTeamSettings
methods.description: Inserts or updates a team's settings in the database.

methods.name: getTeam
methods.description: Retrieves a team by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getTeamsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all teams associated with a user.

methods.name: getTeamCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of teams.

methods.name: teamsFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of team models.

methods.name: getAllTeams
methods.description: Retrieves all teams from the database.
